company_type: Building-materials and lumber-yard retailer serving contractors and DIY/homeowner customers; the site promotes lumber, millwork, kitchens, windows, delivery, field service, and installed sales.

evidence_sources.claim: Founded in 1884 and family-owned at the same Unionville location; operated by Frank, Bob, Ted, and Bobby Sanford.
Four listed locations in Connecticut and western Massachusetts, with addresses, phones, and public business email.
Services include delivery, millwork, shop, field service, drive-through lumber yard, and installed sales.
Company history identifies employment as having grown to nearly fifty.
The site has a contractor/DIY-homeowner signup distinction and promotes products, kitchens, windows, and estimates.

headquarters_location: Unionville, Connecticut, at 1790 Farmington Ave; the company describes this as its original and continuing family location.

millwork_or_field_service_need: High operational relevance: the site explicitly promotes millwork, shop, field service, superior moulding selection, and an Avon Millwork Shop.
